author: Alex Kahn
description: Typed standing automations ("if X do Y") for AI-agent products — a closed trigger/action vocabulary drives the validator, LLM tool schemas, and a capped, cooldown-guarded firing engine, so the agent itself can author rules without hallucinating behavior.
name: @absolutejs/rules

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target=bun && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run test && bun run build && bun publish
